title: Help me start making a game? :)
author: cocoawithoutthea
selftext:
Hello! Im not sure if this post will be allowed  
But I was hoping to start making a roblox game and I have claude but I am not sure how to start. Would someone be happy to help me and I am beyond happy to pay them too for their time!  
Thank you! :)

comments.author: NSTStudios
comments.body: Ask this to Claude. Seriously. And then go from there.

replies.author: Ok-Investment4414
replies.body: u beat me to it... OP ask ai... why because it will breakdown the stuff for you 1:1 with the secrets of your game ... its easier to help from 1 to something vs from 0 .

replies.author: Elegant_Tech
replies.body: Exactly this. Just explain in plain words what you want to do and your goal. Then at the end start by asking it to help you set up your computer and check for any programs that need to be installed to do the work. After your computer is setup ask it to create and plan for the type of game you want to make. You can then begin to iterate from there. The big thing is to just have it do stuff and ask questions. The AI knows and can do it all but can't go on a tangent to provide other options unless you ask. If you ask about different things, ways, options though it can provide you the answers that it wouldn't otherwise have given. The big thing is to research so you know the right questions to ask.
